failure.headline: OceanUNet reconstructs the column better than climatology, but loses to yesterday's 3D field.
why: Daily North Indian Ocean temperature has long memory. Persistence RMSE is 0.17 °C; the U-Net is 0.82 °C.
Surface satellites (SST, SSS, SLA, currents, winds) do not uniquely determine thermocline structure. Peak error is 1.29 °C at 100 m.
Predicted variance is 79–90% of truth in the thermocline — the network smooths fronts and eddies.
Below 500 m the surface is weakly coupled; the U-Net is slightly worse than the 2018–2022 climatology.
failure.not_a_forecast: This head is same-day 3D reconstruction from satellites, not a 7-day forecast. Persistence is a hard baseline, not a rival forecast model.
